detail.longDescription: My morning browser setup: open a new tab → weather + world clocks → check 3-day forecast → write 3 outcomes for the day → THEN open Slack. The sequence is the point. You're making decisions before entering reactive mode. https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/my-15- minute-morning-startup-routine-and-why-i-open-weather-before-slack-3m3n # Productivity # RemoteWork
